bio: The Kensington is situated in the heart of leafy Kensington, within walking distance of the Victoria and Albert, Natural History and Science Museum. Housed in a Georgian townhouse, it feels more like a home away from home rather than a traditional hotel.  The Kensington has long been passionate ambassadors for the arts, with a thriving local community around it, including some of the best galleries London has to offer. To celebrate this enduring cultural connection, they have created an Afternoon Tea menu with a difference – namely a carefully curated collection of desserts inspired by some of the most renowned artists the world has ever seen. It’s afternoon tea, down to a fine art.  A credit card is needed to secure your booking. If you fail to show up for your booking or do not cancel your booking more than 48 hours in advance you may be charged the full offer price. Please note this is a 'book now, pay when you dine' basis. When a booking is made via the site, there is nothing to pay until you dine, so your card will only be charged if you fail to show up for the booking or you do not cancel within 48 hours.  If you have any dietary requirements we kindly ask you to advise the hotel at least 48 hours before your reservation to allow the chef time to prepare. Items on the menu are subject to change to cater to dietary requirements.  *Please note* a 12.5% service charge will be added to the final bill.
